radar.comment: Read radar-beta and an optional colon, either joined or separated by ASCII padding and directives. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and radar.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows radar.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows radar.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows radar.md#hidden-forms-and-comments.
Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows radar.md#composite-common-forms.
Read word keywords before ids, leaving a longer id whole. Follows radar.md#names-and-keyword-boundaries.
Read the listed graticule and boolean values before ids. Follows radar.md#names-and-keyword-boundaries and radar.md#grammar.
Read unsigned decimal numbers before ids, checking the dot boundary through following directives. Follows radar.md#numbers-and-strings and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read matching quoted labels and backslash escapes. Follows radar.md#numbers-and-strings.
Read separators, label delimiters and entry-list braces; description braces are read by the common form. Follows radar.md#grammar.
Read declared axis and curve ids and named-entry references. Follows radar.md#names-and-keyword-boundaries.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

radar-line-final-keywords.comment: Read a reserved keyword at a statement start when only padding and directives follow on its physical line. A value on a later line receives the surrounding context's scopes. Follows radar.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
